profile.headline: Software Engineer V at Grainger
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Engineering leader with 18 years building the platforms, operating models, and technical
foundations that help organizations move faster, operate more reliably, and scale with less
friction.

Areas of Focus:

Agentic Development Platform (ADP) - Building production agentic AI platforms across three pillars. Control
plane for governance, agent identity, agent and tool registries, and policy enforcement.
Execution engine for durable agent orchestration, event-driven triggers, agent harnesses,
and runtime guardrails. Developer platform with golden paths, evals, and observability for
repeatable AI delivery.

Platform Engineering and Cloud Foundations - Internal developer platforms where
security, observability, and compliance are inherited by default. Multi-cloud architecture,
large-scale migration programs, and Kubernetes platform design with multi-tenancy and
policy enforcement. DevOps, DevSecOps, and SRE practices unified under a single
delivery model.

Architecture and Modernization - Architectural direction across modernization programs
and distributed systems at scale. Event-driven and domain-event architectures with
append-only systems of record. Architecture review boards and engineering standards.
Data and AI/ML Foundations. Data architecture and real-time streaming as the substrate
AI runs on. MLOps spanning model lifecycle, fine-tuning, RAG, context engineering, and
inference optimization.

Security and Compliance by Design - Architecting for regulated environments including
HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and SOX. Disaster recovery, RTO/RPO planning, and business continuity.
Compliance designed as structural, not procedural.
Founding Engineering Leadership. Brought in to start things, not maintain them. Build the
foundation, set the team up, and hand over a system that scales without you. Technology
roadmaps, build-vs-buy at scale, vendor evaluation, and budget ownership across CapEx
and OpEx.

positions.title: Founder | AI Engineering
positions.description:
Built to solve a problem every on-call engineer knows personally: 2am alerts with no context, no clear root cause, and a system too complex to investigate manually under pressure.

Draxor.ai is an AI-native incident resolution platform that cuts MTTR through systematic hypothesis testing. Built on three core components: a temporal context graph that maintains a living, timestamped map of the entire stack including application dependencies, infrastructure state and deployment history; an AI root cause analysis agent that investigates incidents by traversing application dependencies, correlating observability data, code changes and infrastructure drift to generate and systematically falsify ranked probabilistic hypotheses; and a real-time integration layer that ingests alerts from PagerDuty, ServiceNow, Slack and GitHub while pulling live telemetry from Datadog, New Relic, AWS, GCP and Azure, enabling real-time cross-stack incident investigation.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · React.js · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · RagGraph · Python · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Next.js · FastAPI · WebSocket · Neo4j · Fine Tuning · MCP · Redis · A2A · Large Language Models (LLM) · PostgreSQL · Agentic AI

positions.title: Head of AI Engineering
positions.description:
Valene Health builds AI-powered clinical workflow automation for health systems.
 
Sole technical leader since inception, bringing nearly two decades of building enterprise-scale AI, cloud, and platform infrastructure in highly regulated industries. Own technology strategy, architecture, and product direction, and built the engineering team that delivers it.
 
• Work closely with the co-founders to define the platform roadmap and reshape it as the AI landscape shifts 
• Architect the agentic AI platform behind clinical automation across health systems 
• Hold the platform to enterprise-grade reliability, security, and compliance as it scales
positions.insights: Skills: Noise Cancellation · React.js · Python · Next.js · FastAPI · Microsoft Azure · WebSocket · Fine Tuning · VoiceAI · TTS · Clinical Workflow · MCP · Webrtc · LiveKit · Redis · STT · VAD · Large Language Models (LLM) · PostgreSQL · Session Initiation Protocol (SIP)

positions.title: Director of Engineering | Principal Architect
positions.description:
Led the full technology strategy, architecture, and engineering organization. Owned build vs buy decisions, vendor evaluation, engineering standards, and offshore development team leadership. Established the organization's first AI capabilities, delivering production LLM and RAG foundations for enterprise-wide adoption.

• Architected and delivered an omnichannel ecommerce platform with enterprise-wide integrations across inventory management, warehouse operations, EDI transactions, ERP, merchandising, marketing and finance systems, establishing a unified technology backbone for the rebuilt organization
• Engineered a custom baby registry platform from scratch and built an AI agent on top that interviews new parents on preferences and autonomously assembles a personalized product registry with a shareable link for review and modification, directly addressing friction in a multi-million dollar registry business. Also delivered production LLM solutions including automated invoice processing and intelligent real-time price matching, underpinned by an LLM infrastructure, RAG pipelines and prompt engineering standards designed as a reusable foundation for AI adoption across the organization
• Built a real-time analytics platform on Microsoft Fabric, consolidating data from ecommerce, POS, inventory and supply chain systems to power merchandising decisions, demand forecasting and operational intelligence across business units
• Established Cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices covering CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, container orchestration and observability, enabling reliable delivery at scale across the engineering organization
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · React.js · Data Analytics · Data Warehousing · Microsoft Fabric · Python · Next.js · FastAPI · Data Lakes · Event Driven · Apache Spark · Machine Learning · Redis · Large Language Models (LLM) · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Manager of Platform Engineering
positions.description:
Built and scaled the platform engineering function from the ground up, growing a team of 8 engineers to serve a 300+ developer organization. Owned the platform engineering roadmap and CapEx/OpEx budget, responsible for engineering standards, developer experience and delivery performance across the enterprise.

• Defined and enforced enterprise-wide engineering standards covering CI/CD, security, compliance and deployment practices, creating a consistent, governed foundation that reduced variability and risk across all engineering teams
• Built an Internal Developer Platform that gave 300+ developers self-service access to environments, pipelines and infrastructure, eliminating deployment bottlenecks that previously required weeks of manual coordination and compressing release cycles to single-click operations
• Introduced DORA metrics across the engineering organization, establishing the first data-driven framework for measuring delivery performance and giving leadership concrete visibility into deployment frequency, lead time, failure rates and recovery time
• Drove substantial cloud cost reduction through a FinOps program that introduced spend governance, resource optimization and cost accountability across engineering teams, turning cloud spend from an unmanaged operational expense into a governed, measurable line item
• Dismantled organizational silos between development, DevOps and SRE teams by building shared platform ownership, unified tooling and collaborative workflows that aligned previously fragmented teams around a common delivery model

positions.title: Solutions Architect - Cloud
positions.description:
Drove enterprise cloud transformation across application modernization and data center migration, partnering with cross-functional teams across ecommerce, store operations, marketing, supply chain, data warehousing and enterprise infrastructure.

• Architected and executed the migration of 160+ enterprise applications and 2,500+ servers from on-premise data centers to cloud, defining migration patterns, sequencing workloads by business criticality and maintaining business continuity throughout the multi-year transformation program
• Established enterprise cloud-native modernization standards including microservices decomposition, containerization, headless commerce architecture and CI/CD automation, creating a repeatable modernization playbook adopted across engineering teams
• Core contributor to the enterprise-wide migration from legacy JDA and AS400 systems to Oracle Cloud, one of the most complex and business-critical transformation programs in the organization spanning finance, supply chain, merchandising and operations
• Modernized the enterprise integration layer by migrating from legacy TIBCO middleware to MuleSoft, rearchitecting enterprise-wide system integrations and establishing an API-led connectivity model connecting ecommerce, ERP, supply chain and store systems
• Active contributor to the Architecture Review Board, presenting architectural proposals, conducting design reviews and driving adoption of standardized patterns and governance practices across engineering teams

positions.title: Solutions Architect - DevOps/SRE
positions.description:
• Architected the hybrid and multi-cloud foundation across GCP, Azure and on-premise data centers, establishing private network connectivity between environments, federated identity management integrating on-premise Active Directory with cloud IAM systems, consistent security policy enforcement across all infrastructure boundaries and shared platform services enabling workloads to operate seamlessly across the entire hybrid estate
• Implemented enterprise-scale configuration management across 4,000+ servers spanning on-premise and cloud environments, enforcing desired state to eliminate configuration drift, ensure security compliance and automate patch management, replacing weeks of manual administration with continuous, self-correcting automation
• Established infrastructure as code practices using declarative provisioning and immutable machine image pipelines, making all infrastructure reproducible, version-controlled and auditable, reducing provisioning time from days to minutes and enabling complete environment recreation for disaster recovery
• Integrated enterprise service management with infrastructure automation, creating end-to-end workflows from request through approval to automated provisioning, with real-time CMDB synchronization ensuring a continuously accurate, audit-ready inventory of all infrastructure assets
• Engineered an enterprise-grade Kubernetes platform with multi-tenancy support across multiple regions, implementing namespace-based workload isolation, RBAC-driven access controls, network policy enforcement and container image scanning to establish a security-hardened container orchestration foundation
• Established a modern CI/CD platform using pipeline as code, integrating automated testing, static code analysis and artifact security controls, embedding quality and security gates into every release and enabling consistent, auditable deployments at enterprise scale

positions.title: Automation Architect
positions.description: TD's interest rate platform operated across multiple US states and Canada, where every deployment required a full overnight regression cycle to validate rate calculations and ensure compliance before business hours. Architected automated ETL validation pipelines and a Selenium WebDriver test automation framework in Java that compressed multi-hour overnight regression cycles to minutes, significantly reducing compliance risk and manual QA effort across each release cycle.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Test Automation · Selenium WebDriver

positions.title: Senior System Engineer
positions.description: Managed enterprise VMware virtualization infrastructure across development, QA and staging environments. Led migration to enterprise SAN solution, improving performance and scalability across the organization.
positions.insights: Skills: Active Directory · Storage Area Network (SAN) · VMWare ESXi

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Built enterprise Java applications and high-volume transaction processing systems using J2EE, Spring Framework and Hibernate. Developed RESTful web services, optimized database queries, and implemented unit testing with JUnit across production systems.
